annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: The organizer probably expects me to take the review
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: since they offered it right after hearing how our split went

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: the other worker thinks the matter's closed
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: because the payment went through without anyone asking questions

annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: If the other worker had some emergency that morning

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: The organizer likely wants these deals to feel trustworthy
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: since they run the jobs and need people willing to sign up

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: They'd likely feel singled out rather than corrected.
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: since I'm the only one who knew about our arrangement

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: I suspect the other worker assumed I'd just let it go
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: given that we won't cross paths again

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: The organizer may think a review is what anyone in my spot would want
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: because from their view it's the standard fix

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: they might have figured the payment was already settled
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: Something may have gone badly for the other worker that day.

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: The other worker likely expected the split to stay informal
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: given it was just an agreement between the two of us

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: The organizer seems to believe fairness here means someone has to answer
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: which fits their job of keeping these arrangements honest
